paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
notes: Paper sets 90% CL upper limits on dark photon (and solar dark photon) absorption as bosonic DM via S2-only single/few-electron analysis in XENON1T. Coupling type is DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing chi). However, the provided content cuts off before the limit-setting results section (Section VI), so no numerical (mass, chi) data points are available in the extractable text. The paper also discusses DM-electron scattering, electric/magnetic dipole, and anapole interactions, but the new excluded parameter space is for dark photons. DM density assumption (0.3 GeV/cm^3 standard for direct detection) is typical but not explicitly confirmed in the provided text. | read-vote N=3: ct=DarkPhoton (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
